hints.title: Reference Landmark
hints.text: Locate an open door first without modifying it so it serves as the origin marker.

hints.title: Bounded Single Lap Scan
hints.text: Step forward through up to k houses, closing every open door encountered.

hints.title: Lap Return Detection
hints.text: The step count corresponding to the last open door closed in the pass marks the exact perimeter length.

hints.title: Bounded Traversal Code

variables: k: maximum bound on house count
complexity.notes: Single pass of length k across circular houses.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without an open reference door, a closed loop cannot be detected.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory without recording house history.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains an unmodified open reference marker and closes doors on arrival.
